text: APPROVE. The loop body moves unchanged into `ParseContainer`, and the `Where(ValueKind == Object)` filter replaces the `continue`. `AddRange` still runs inside the same `try`, so behaviour on `JsonException` is unchanged. The removed `foreach`/`if`/`continue` bring `Parse` under 15, and the new helper (a few ternaries and `&&` chains) is well under the threshold. The code should build, but I did not run it.
